title: The Rice Husk Plant in Tamkuha and the Villagers Who Paid for Light
conflicts: Credit for the first plant: 2010 reports name Pandey and Ratnesh Yadav; Manoj Sinha's later accounts describe the experiment as his and Pandey's; the story credits Pandey and Yadav for 2007 and has Sinha and Ransler join for the 2008 company, quoting Sinha's account of being paid. Scale figures differ by date (125+ villages July 2010, 200 villages Sept 2010, 80 plants/350 villages June 2011, 65 plants/32,500 households March 2011); Ashden's dated plant and household count used. Monthly fee Rs 80 (PTI, Business Standard 2010) vs Rs 100 (Ashden, Weekend Leader); story says 80 to 100. First equity round $1.65m Dec 2009 (Ashden) vs $1.56m 2010 (Business Standard 2017); not used.
notes: Funding is mixed: the first plant went up through the founders' own NGO (Samta Samriddhi Foundation), then prize money, Shell Foundation grants, social-investor equity and government capital subsidies. Stance 'complicates' (Plato on the art of pay).
